final: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT circuitId, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races GROUP BY circuitId), shares AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, 1.0 * race_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM races) AS share FROM circuit_counts), ranked AS (SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS excess FROM shares), cutoff AS (SELECT excess FROM ranked ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT circuitId, race_count, share, excess FROM ranked WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AND excess >= (SELECT excess FROM cutoff) ORDER BY excess DESC
